about: Shared schema profile: every table and column with its meaning, role, missing values, common values, links and applicable query conventions. Read by the query system.
maintenance: Shared snapshot: regenerate only with `python scripts/prepare_mimic3.py publish` (dataset maintainer); do not edit by hand.
small_count_rule: Counts from 1 to 10 are written as "<11" and their percentage as null; category values seen in fewer than 11 rows are omitted.

role_meanings.row_number: Row number within the table; not an identifier, never join on it
role_meanings.identifier: Identifies one record of this table (its key)
role_meanings.reference: Points to a record in another table (see 'references')
role_meanings.code: A code from a coding system (ICD-9, CPT, DRG, NDC, ...), stored as text
role_meanings.local_identifier: An identifier with no table of its own in this dataset (e.g. ward, order)
role_meanings.time: Date or date-time (shifted into the future per patient; intervals are real)
role_meanings.category: One of a small set of values (listed under 'values')
role_meanings.text: Free or semi-free text; match with patterns (ILIKE), not exact values
role_meanings.always_null: Always empty in this dataset; do not filter or group on it

key_hierarchy: subject_id (patient) > hadm_id (hospital admission) > icustay_id (ICU stay): each ICU stay belongs to one admission and each admission to one patient. Join on the most specific identifier both tables share.

admissions.description: One row per hospital admission: admission and discharge times, admission type and location, insurance, demographics, admitting diagnosis text, and in-hospital death.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

deathtime.description: Time of in-hospital death; null if the patient did not die in hospital

admission_location.description: Where the patient was admitted from, e.g. 'EMERGENCY ROOM ADMIT', 'PHYS REFERRAL/NORMAL DELI', 'TRANSFER FROM HOSP/EXTRAM', 'CLINIC REFERRAL/PREMATURE'

discharge_location.description: Where the patient went after discharge, e.g. 'HOME', 'HOME HEALTH CARE', 'SNF', 'REHAB/DISTINCT PART HOSP', 'DEAD/EXPIRED'

language.description: Preferred language, 4-letter uppercase abbreviations such as 'ENGL', 'SPAN'; often null

religion.description: Religion, uppercase free text, e.g. 'CATHOLIC', 'NOT SPECIFIED'

ethnicity.description: Uppercase free text with subgroups, e.g. 'WHITE', 'BLACK/AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'ASIAN - CHINESE', 'UNKNOWN/NOT SPECIFIED'; use prefix patterns such as 'ASIAN%' for groups

edregtime.description: Time registered in the emergency department

diagnosis.description: Free-text preliminary admitting diagnosis (uppercase), not coded; use diagnoses_icd for coded diagnoses

hospital_expire_flag.description: 1 if the patient died during this admission, else 0

has_chartevents_data.description: 1 if the admission has ICU charted data

callout.description: ICU discharge planning: requests to move a patient out of the ICU ('call outs') and their outcomes.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

callout_service.description: Service the patient is called out to

discharge_wardid.description: Ward the patient was discharged to

caregivers.description: Caregivers who documented data (cgid), with their role; no clinical content.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

cgid.description: Caregiver identifier (joins cgid in the ICU event tables)

cptevents.description: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) codes billed for ICU and respiratory services; billing-oriented, mostly professional services.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

cpt_cd.description: CPT code as text, e.g. '99291' (critical care, first hour)

cpt_number.description: Numeric part of the CPT code

cpt_suffix.description: Letter suffix of the CPT code

ticket_id_seq.description: Order of codes on the billing ticket

d_cpt.description: High-level CPT code ranges (sections and subsections), not individual codes; match cptevents.cpt_number to a range.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

sectionrange.description: Range of codes in the section

subsectionrange.description: Range of codes in the subsection

mincodeinsubsection.description: Lowest code number in the subsection

maxcodeinsubsection.description: Highest code number in the subsection

d_icd_diagnoses.description: Dictionary of ICD-9-CM diagnosis codes: code to short and long title.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

icd9_code.description: ICD-9-CM diagnosis code without the dot (joins diagnoses_icd.icd9_code)

long_title.description: Full title, e.g. 'Diabetes mellitus without mention of complication, type II or unspecified type, not stated as uncontrolled'

d_icd_procedures.description: Dictionary of ICD-9-CM procedure codes: code to short and long title.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

icd9_code.description: ICD-9-CM procedure code without the dot (joins procedures_icd.icd9_code)

d_items.description: Dictionary of non-lab items: ITEMID to label, category, unit, source system, and the event table that uses it (CHARTEVENTS, INPUTEVENTS_CV/MV, OUTPUTEVENTS, PROCEDUREEVENTS_MV, DATETIMEEVENTS, MICROBIOLOGYEVENTS).

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

itemid.description: Item identifier (joins the itemid of the table in linksto)

dbsource.description: 'carevue' or 'metavision': the same concept has different itemids in each system

linksto.description: Lowercase name of the event table that uses this itemid, e.g. 'chartevents', 'procedureevents_mv'

d_labitems.description: Dictionary of laboratory tests: lab ITEMID to test name, fluid, category, and LOINC code. Dictionary only: lab results are in LABEVENTS.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

loinc_code.description: LOINC code, e.g. '4548-4'; may be null

datetimeevents.description: ICU observations whose value is a date or time (e.g. date of last dialysis, line insertion time), not a measurement.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

diagnoses_icd.description: Hospital-assigned ICD-9 diagnosis codes for each admission, assigned at discharge for billing, ordered by priority.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

seq_num.description: Priority of the diagnosis within the admission; 1 = primary diagnosis

icd9_code.description: ICD-9-CM diagnosis code stored as text WITHOUT the dot: 250.00 is '25000', 401.9 is '4019', V45.81 is 'V4581'

drgcodes.description: Diagnosis Related Groups (billing) for each admission, with severity and mortality ratings for APR-DRGs.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

drg_type.description: 'HCFA', 'MS' (Medicare Severity), or 'APR ' (All Patient Refined; stored with a trailing space, so compare TRIM(drg_type) = 'APR')

drg_severity.description: Severity of illness 1-4 (APR only; null otherwise)

drg_mortality.description: Risk of mortality 1-4 (APR only; null otherwise)

icustays.description: One row per ICU stay: care units, ICU in/out times, length of stay, and source system.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

first_careunit.description: First ICU type: 'MICU' (medical), 'SICU' (surgical), 'CCU' (coronary care), 'CSRU' (cardiac surgery recovery), 'TSICU' (trauma surgical), 'NICU' (neonatal)

last_careunit.description: Last ICU type (same values as first_careunit)

los.description: ICU length of stay in fractional days

inputevents_cv.description: ICU fluid and medication inputs documented in the CareVue system (2001-2008).

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

microbiologyevents.description: Microbiology tests: specimens, organisms grown, and antibiotic sensitivities.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

charttime.description: Time of the test (may be null)

org_name.description: Organism grown, uppercase, e.g. 'STAPH AUREUS COAG +', 'ESCHERICHIA COLI'; null means no growth

patients.description: One row per patient: gender, date of birth, and dates of death.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

dob.description: Date of birth (shifted). Patients older than 89 at their first admission have DOB shifted so that their age appears as about 300 years

dod.description: Date of death from any source (hospital or social security records); null if not known to have died

dod_hosp.description: Date of death recorded in the hospital database

dod_ssn.description: Date of death from the social security database

expire_flag.description: 1 if the patient has died (dod is not null), else 0

prescriptions.description: Medication orders (not confirmed administration): drug, dose, route, and dates.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

icustay_id.description: ICU stay identifier if ordered in the ICU

drug.description: Drug name as ordered (free text, mixed case)

drug_name_poe.description: Drug name in the order entry system

procedureevents_mv.description: Procedures documented in the ICU (MetaVision patients only, 2008-2012), e.g. ventilation, dialysis, line insertion, imaging, with start and end times.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

procedures_icd.description: ICD-9 procedure codes for each admission, ordered by sequence.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

seq_num.description: Order of the procedure within the admission

icd9_code.description: ICD-9-CM procedure code WITHOUT the dot: 36.10 is '3610', 96.71 is '9671'

services.description: Clinical service the patient was under during an admission (e.g. medicine, surgery), with the time of each service change.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

transfertime.description: Time the patient moved to the current service

prev_service.description: Previous service (null for the first one)

transfers.description: Patient movements between hospital units and beds during an admission, including ICU admission and discharge events.

row_id.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins

icustay_id.description: ICU stay identifier when the movement is part of an ICU stay; else null

prev_careunit.description: Previous ICU type (null for non-ICU wards)

curr_careunit.description: Current ICU type: 'MICU', 'SICU', 'CCU', 'CSRU', 'TSICU', 'NICU'; null for non-ICU wards

intime.description: Time the patient entered the current unit

outtime.description: Time the patient left the current unit

los.description: Length of stay in the current unit, in hours
